description: Verified dry access; all evidence attested for hypothetical configured resources.
Unknown depth must never clear a road vehicle; helicopters independently reviewed.
Shallow flooded case plus nearby closure excludes every road asset.
Strong current and vulnerable people; no sled or generic volunteer/paddle craft.
Bedridden/wheelchair patient requires confirmed secured-litter capability.
Roof without eaves transfer or engineered LZ: verified hoist or technical team only.
Deep water, debris, suspected electricity and obstructed flight path: exclude entry.
A capable thermal drone still cannot fly without airspace authorization.
